Bet9ja selected-sports sidebar, live DOM export

Captured from the rendered Bet9ja sidebar after opening each listed sport. Ice Hockey's A–Z control was opened to its “Show less” state.

Source page at capture: Bet9ja WNBA.

Observed navigation contract

  1. Click sport root left_prematch_sport-<sport_id>_<slug>_label-toggle.
  2. If present, click left_prematch_sport-<sport_id>_<slug>_buttonmore-toggle while its visible label contains “more”.
  3. Click each group ..._sg-<group_id>_<slug>_label-toggle.
  4. Read resulting competition links matching a[id*="_g-"]. Their DOM href is javascript:;; the click handler performs navigation.
